market_name: Will Trump be impeached by end of 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move coincides with a concrete news catalyst (scandal, indictment, House vote scheduling) versus thin-market noise; confirm SPY/ES futures reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare SPY move to VIX and Treasury futures to see if a genuine risk-off regime is forming rather than idiosyncratic drift.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether headline is corroborated by major outlets (already public) or leading the news; gauge fade vs continuation.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether equity move persisted or mean-reverted; check overnight futures for follow-through.
time_plan.12h: Mark final SPY return vs baseline; log whether impeachment odds and equities co-moved or decoupled to refine future mapping.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a Trump impeachment would signal elevated political instability, potentially rising after a scandal or a shift in the House balance. Historically, political-uncertainty shocks produce mild, short-lived equity risk-off moves. But impeachment without Senate conviction is largely symbolic, policy continuity is high, and markets have repeatedly shrugged off impeachment headlines (2019 Trump impeachment barely dented the S&P). Net 12h effect is small and directionally ambiguous, well below the 700bps tradable threshold.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and UUP for any immediate reaction; likely negligible.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check against 2-year yield moves to separate rate-driven from politics-driven FX action.
time_plan.2h: Confirm whether any move is USD-specific or broad risk sentiment.
time_plan.6h: Reassess persistence; expect noise to dominate.
time_plan.12h: Record net UUP return and whether it correlated at all with the impeachment-odds shift.

predictions.reasoning: Domestic US political turmoil has an ambiguous dollar effect: safe-haven flows can support USD even when the US is the source of risk, while governance concerns can weaken it. The 12h impeachment-probability signal is a very weak and noisy driver for FX, which is dominated by rate differentials and macro data. Mapping is weak; low confidence and unclear direction are appropriate.

evidence_used: Market resolves Yes only on a House majority vote on articles of impeachment, not conviction/removal
Impeachment requires a House majority, so a large odds move likely implies a scandal or a shift in expected 2026 midterm control
Historical precedent: the 2019 Trump impeachment had minimal, transient effect on US equities
Standard behavior of equities and FX to domestic political-uncertainty shocks
uncertainty_notes: Impeachment without Senate conviction is largely symbolic; policy and macro continuity is high, muting asset impact
A probability move may reflect thin Polymarket liquidity/noise rather than genuine information
Direction of USD response to US political risk is genuinely ambiguous (safe-haven vs governance discount)
The market has a long horizon (through end-2026) so short 12h asset windows are only loosely linked

llm_justification.summary: A sharp move in the odds Trump is impeached by end-2026 maps only weakly to 12h public-market moves. The most plausible channel is a mild equity risk-off if a genuine scandal or House-control shift drives the odds, but impeachment without Senate conviction is largely symbolic and history (2019) shows minimal, transient equity impact. Both the SPY and USD mappings are low-confidence and directionally unclear, and neither is expected to reach the 700bps tradable threshold. This is best treated as a non-tradable, monitor-only signal.
key_assumptions: The odds move is driven by real political news rather than illiquid-market noise
Markets treat symbolic impeachment as low economic-impact, consistent with 2019
No simultaneous macro catalyst (Fed, CPI) dominates the tape
failure_modes: The impeachment odds shift is already public/priced, so no asset reaction occurs
Any equity dip quickly reverses as markets discount a symbolic, non-conviction impeachment
SPY/USD are weak proxies whose 12h moves are dominated by rates and macro, not political odds
Direction assumed wrong: safe-haven flows could lift both USD and equities, or a 'buy the news' rally could occur
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
